title: Shocked Face Gaming Thumbnail
tests: Tests composing a generated face and exact three-word typography into one readable widescreen thumbnail.

faults.what: The image is slightly wider than an exact 16:9 frame; a small crop or resize would correct it.

judge.summary: A bright, punchy gaming thumbnail with excellent headline readability and a large shocked face, needing only a slight aspect-ratio adjustment.

must_haves.why: One finished thumbnail is present, but the displayed image is slightly wider than 16:9.

must_haves.item: A large, clearly visible human face on the right with a shocked expression.
must_haves.why: The right side features a prominent human face with wide eyes, an open mouth, and hands against the cheeks.

must_haves.item: The headline reads exactly “ONE LAST TRY”, with no additional words.
must_haves.why: The only visible words are ONE LAST TRY, correctly spelled.

must_haves.item: The headline sits on the left, is high-contrast and does not cover the face.
must_haves.why: Large yellow and white lettering with thick black outlines occupies the left side without obscuring the face.
